title: Mikveh / Immersion Pools
summary: Immersion pools were used in Jewish purity practices and help explain the setting of washings and baptism discussions.
background: Jewish life included immersion for certain purity concerns. This background helps readers understand why water, washing, and purification language had deep cultural context.
teachingHelp: Use this topic for historical background, while letting the New Testament define baptism’s meaning in context.
